name: pdf-decompiler-mcp
description: Local-first, bounded and cited PDF decomposition and retrieval over MCP.

allowed_directories.title: Allowed PDF directories
allowed_directories.description: Select the directories from which this server may open local PDFs.

tools.name: pdf_open
tools.description: Open, validate, decompose, index, or load a PDF generation.

tools.name: pdf_document_info
tools.description: Return document, decomposition, cache, warning, and resource-lifetime information.

tools.name: pdf_search
tools.description: Search with BM25 or optional semantic and hybrid retrieval.

tools.name: pdf_get_pages
tools.description: Retrieve cited page elements under explicit modes and budgets.

tools.name: pdf_get_element
tools.description: Resolve one element in an exact extraction generation.

tools.name: pdf_render_page
tools.description: Render a bounded page or crop as inline image content or an immutable resource.

tools.name: pdf_close
tools.description: Release an active document and optionally delete its cache generation.
